LANDING_INTRO: Get a full overview with simple logging and a daily reminder. Easily import your data on this page. Developed in collaboration with gynecologists and endometriosis specialists.
LANDING_DISCLAIMER: The purpose of the solution is to enable the user to record relevant information about endometriosis, symptoms, menstruation and medications. The solution offers storage of information and easy sharing between healthcare provider and user. The solution does not provide medical conclusions, or analysis and decision support based on user data. The solution offers general information based on recognised guidelines.
CODE_HELP_TITLE: How to share your data from the app
CODE_HELP_STEP_2: A six-digit code is shown at the top of the screen.
CODE_HELP_STEP_3: Enter the code in the field on this page and press {start}. The code is valid for 10 minutes – if it expires, you can generate a new one in the app.

CMP_HINT: For example the start of a treatment. Each period is 30 days.
CMP_CHANGE: Change from before to after the reference date
CMP_NOTE: The average only includes periods with registrations. Change = (average after − average before) ÷ average before. Periods after the date that have not ended or have no registrations are left out of the change.
SUM_INTRO: {range}: The patient has had {pain} days with pain, of which {severe} were heavy or extreme. Bleeding on {period} days. Acute medication on {medication} days.
SUM_FOOTNOTE: *Sum = Light × 1 + Medium × 2 + Heavy × 3 + Extreme × 4 (the month sum in the app). Not shown for the current period.
